olga: noticing repeated p95 spikes on rack-22 (usw2) aligned with heavy multi-tenant transfers over NVSwitch.

matt: paste small counters?

olga: nvlink_retries=67, hbm_util=88%, txq_depth=[90,92,89,91]

ravi: tenants: cool-ml (background), payments (latency-sensitive), embedder (batch)

matt: quick fix: throttle background or avoid rack-22 for batch. ops-bot can flip an avoid tag?

olga: prefer soft-avoid so we don't starve other racks. Also emit tenant_isolation_score metric for billing.

ops-bot: tag flip queued: rack_tag=nvlink_hot -> action=soft_avoid_batches duration=1800s

sre-oncall: suggest alert nvlink_retries>50 (5m) -> P2 page, would've caught earlier

ravi: I'll run a 4h trial and collect p95 + throughput and export results to billing for isolation candidates

matt: ok owners: ravi (trial + metrics), olga (inventory check for mixed hw), matt (allocator soft-avoid change). Revisit EOD.

olga: thanks team — monitoring now :eyes:
